segments.comment: Independent wizard-mode visit to the top Sokoban level, a level teleport to a new Dungeons of Doom level, and a return. save.c savelev() keeps the Sokoban level's monster-generation exclusion zone (dungeon.c save_exclusions()), mklev.c clear_level_structures() frees it, and restore.c getlev() reloads it (dungeon.c load_exclusions()). The blind, sleeping hero then waits on a scare monster scroll until makemon.c makemon_rnd_goodpos() draws a square inside that zone, which teleport.c goodpos() rejects. The seed, clock, character, and input were chosen for this path.
